data.name: Karthi
data.gender_notes: Karthi is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Karthi means 'Son of God'. This powerful name is derived from the Hindu deity Kartikeya, also known as Murugan or Skanda, who is the god of war, courage, and wisdom. Karthi embodies the divine qualities of bravery, strength, and intelligence. The name Karthi carries the meaning “Son of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Karthi usually hope their child will grow to embody son of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodiment of divine courage and wisdom.
data.etymology: Karthi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Son of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Karthi total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
